newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday following late U.S. dollar demand from importers, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.498 against Tuesday's T$27.495 close. Turnover was a moderate US$154.50.

Dealers expected a stable rate to persist in the near future. "Late commercial demand for the U.S. dollar pulled it up a little, but the buying was only temporary and the flat trend remained unaffected," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.49-50 range was seen for Thursday. -K. Chen (5080815)
